Q8522.reason: Under UNCLOS, baselines are the reference line from which the breadth of the territorial sea, contiguous zone, EEZ, and continental shelf is measured.

Q8523.reason: Before the UN Charter, resort to war was still generally lawful, limited only by narrow rules such as the League Covenant and the Kellogg-Briand Pact.

Q8526.reason: Acute post-lift radiculopathy with a positive straight-leg raise and lost ankle reflex is the classic picture of lumbar disc herniation (nucleus pulposus displacement).
